label: PROTOTYPE ASSUMPTION - demo values only
note: These numeric targets were chosen for this prototype. They are not any company's policy and are not specified by the original framework, which states postures only (P0: same-hour human review; P1: same-day investigation). Edit this file to change them.
unconfirmed_case_basis: Before a human confirms severity, deadlines use the control-adjusted AI recommendation; if no assessment exists (e.g. provider failure) the P1 target is used so the case is not left without a deadline.
auto_hold_note: C7 automatic session pause (P0 CBRN / child safety): a person must confirm or lift it within this time; it never lifts itself.
